prompt:
Santa's Speedy Shopper: find five distinct real Christmas gifts for people who enjoy technology. Use web_fetch on both of these live retail catalogs now. The responses contain current product names and links:

https://mercantile.wordpress.org/wp-json/wc/store/v1/products?per_page=6&stock_status=instock&_fields=name,permalink&_run=4a2e1d7b
https://raspberrypi.dk/wp-json/wc/store/v1/products?search=kit&per_page=6&stock_status=instock&_fields=name,permalink&_run=4a2e1d7b

Pick gifts from both retailers. Return exactly five numbered Markdown links, each using the actual product name and its product-page URL from the tool response, followed by one short reason it makes a good gift. Use only items retrieved in this run.
